system.meta: Weapon • Agility (Represents what transfers between every weapon that leaves the hand: judging distance, timing a release, leading a moving target, and shooting past friends. Ranged is a parent Constellation: every Talent you buy in Archery, Crossbow Fighting, or Missile Skirmishing counts toward your Ranged rank.)
system.flareTrigger: Crit succeed or crit fail on any roll with consequences, directly related to a talent in this constellation.
